author: SickProdigy
description: Show Clash of Clans clan, player, war, Clan War League, and Raid Weekend information and notifications.
name: Coc
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store data or metadata about users.
install_msg: This cog contacts the Clash of Clans API and bundles banner images used in responses. Set the bot-wide API key with `[p]set api clashofclans api_key,YOUR_KEY`, then configure each server with `[p]cocset clan <clan_tag>`.
